from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path


def load_policy() -> dict:
    policy_path = Path(__file__).parent / "policy.json"
    with policy_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as policy_file:
        return json.load(policy_file)


def can(user: dict, action: str, object: str, record: dict) -> bool:
    policy = load_policy()

    role = user.get("ROLE_ID", "")
    user_id = user.get("USR_ID", "")
    user_team = user.get("TEAM_CD", "")
    owner_id = record.get("OWNER_UID", "")
    record_team = record.get("TEAM_CD", "")

    grant = None
    for candidate in policy.get("grants", []):
        if (
            candidate.get("role") == role
            and candidate.get("object") == object
            and candidate.get("action") == action
        ):
            grant = candidate
            break

    if grant is None:
        return False

    if (
        action == "DELETE"
        and policy.get("delete_requires_live_record", False)
        and record.get("DEL_FLG", "") not in ("", "N")
    ):
        return False

    if role == policy.get("admin_role"):
        return True

    scope = grant.get("scope")
    if scope == "ALL":
        return True
    if scope == "TEAM":
        return bool(user_team == record_team)
    if scope == "OWN":
        return bool(owner_id == user_id)
    return False
